summary: The most recent orders for one customer: id, status, total. A fixed statement; the customer id is bound.
statement: SELECT id, status, total FROM production.orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

layer2.enforced_by: PostgreSQL: the agent role has SELECT on production.orders and no other privilege, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is on, and the role is NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS (scripts/setup-postgres.sql).
layer2.check: validate/check_postgres.py, connecting as the agent role with no broker in the path
